title: In PcVue version 17.0.0 through 17.0.1 included, user account security settings could be modified. (CVE-2026-112160)
description: PcVue versions 17.0.0 through 17.0.1 contain a vulnerability allowing privileged users to modify user account security settings, including password policies. This could enable unauthorized changes to security configurations. The update aligns user account management with the existing security enforcement model to prevent such unauthorized modifications.
